quote.text: A nation’s existence is a daily plebiscite.
quote.author: Ernest Renan, Qu’est-ce qu’une nation?, lecture at the Sorbonne, 11 March 1882

stories.headline: Albertans vote 75 to 25 to stay in Canada
stories.dek: Elections Alberta’s unofficial count stood at 1,451,579 to 477,642 on Tuesday evening. Only question eight — opting out of federal programmes while keeping the money — failed.

stories.headline: Tefal advertises 7.7 bar and a tailor’s Italian boiler runs 3.5
stories.dek: The IEC’s 60311 standard defines how to measure a steam rate and never mentions pressure. The consumer figure is a pump’s peak; Reliable’s is the working vessel.

stories.headline: Fungi on iNaturalist pass 22.9 million records; Singapore confirms one in ten
stories.dek: Mushroom Observer adds 644,381 more from 91,897 users. In Singapore the confirmation rate is 10.4 per cent — and that gap is the whole invitation.

stories.headline: Shanmugam says Singapore is questioning seven SGX-listed firms over the Indonesian fires
stories.dek: The Senior Minister named bank financing and government grants as levers on 19 October, and said legislation could be amended “on an urgent basis”. Twelve years on, no company has been prosecuted.

stories.headline: Apple commits US$100m to a Pennsylvania titanium mill for the iPhone Duo case
stories.dek: The 20 October release claims nearly 100 components from US firms. Assembly stays in China and India, and JPMorgan has just cut Duo shipments to 8–9 million units.

stories.headline: Apple prices HomeView at S$399 in Singapore; the wall model drops the woofer
stories.dek: Pre-orders opened 15 October and stock ships 13 November. Both versions cost the same, and the wall mount Apple does not include starts at US$59.95.

stories.headline: Ressence’s Type 10 DN runs its first in-house calibre, at CHF 45,000
stories.dek: Unveiled at WatchTime New York on 16 October in 100 pieces, deliveries from November. The brand’s own site already marks it sold out, at €60,000.

stories.kicker: Screen & Sound · You Can See Everything
stories.headline: A24’s Elizabeth Holmes film takes $18,247 a screen on 855 screens
stories.dek: Nathan Fielder and Lance Oppenheim’s documentary opened on 16 October to $15.6m and a Metascore of 97 from 40 reviews. Theranos whistleblower Tyler Shultz says it is not a documentary at all.

stories.kicker: The Family Desk · Social Media And Mood
stories.headline: A Pediatrics study finds no link to anxiety across five waves
stories.dek: The ABCD cohort followed 11,279 adolescents from a mean age of 12.01. Depression ran both ways in two of four intervals; anxiety showed nothing at all.

stories.kicker: The Macro Desk · The Twist Flattener
stories.headline: Brent fell 2.3 per cent on an unconfirmed Qatar plan
stories.dek: The 2s10s spread closed at +33bp on 20 October, from +38. Equities and bonds came apart again: BNDW up 0.18 per cent, VWRA down 0.11.

stories.headline: The ATTICA cohort ties half of later frailty to midlife inactivity
stories.dek: The Greek cohort, published 19 October, puts the population attributable fraction at 49.5 per cent. People who took up exercise did almost as well as those who never stopped.

stories.headline: Tokyo’s Louvre show stops admitting ordinary tickets after 6 December
stories.dek: Timed tickets for 7–13 December go on sale at noon on Friday 31 October. The Kyushu sumo basho is sold out on all fifteen days.

stories.headline: Hanoi puts Vietnam’s new eldercare in offices its own reforms emptied
stories.dek: The first centre opened in Long Biên on 6 June 2026 and six wards now run them. Decree 168/2026 gives the model no legal personality and no central budget line.
